findings.problem: The allowed aztec_getPublicLogsByTags method does not increment tagDiscoveryRequests. A cold window containing that tagged discovery plus one valid compact POST passes the new zero-tag assertion. The counter currently measures private-tag calls only despite the declared zero tagged-discovery contract.
findings.requiredRepair: Count both tagged-log methods (including every batch item), preserve ordinary explicit-action reads outside cold windows, add public-tag-only and mixed-batch negatives demonstrating the actual shared window assertion rejects them.
findings.sourceEvidence: Installed rc3 PXE caching_aztec_node.js lines72-81 forwards public tagged queries; observer nodeReads admits the method, increment branch only matches private method.

findings.problem: The notification driver validates counters and sets passed before awaiting context/browser close, then replaces report.traffic at line214 without validating its final values. A route callback during these awaits can increment deniedWrites/proofSubmits/nodeSubmissions/inspectionErrors while the returned report still says passed. This is an existing reporting gap exposed by the requested all-effects acceptance audit, not a claimed historical incident.
findings.requiredRepair: Reapply finite final traffic invariants after cleanup using the final snapshot: exactly two authorized proof/send phases and counts, no open phase, no L1/blocked/inspection/denied writes, and timeout/cleanup failure cannot pass. Add a deterministic actual-used finalization regression with a late counter change; do not erase counters or inspect foreign errors.

verifiedDesign.compactSelectors: Exact fixed trusted origin/path, checkpointed tier, closed validated public number/hash/schema selector, <=1024-byte POST, no query/fragment/credential routes; preflights separately counted. Returned block authority remains downstream compact authentication.
verifiedDesign.coldWindows: Preference starts before unlock/import. Notification starts before each fresh-context import, and before return-to-private-views after each confirmed transaction. Fresh contexts require positive compact POST observation. Action preparation stays outside these windows.
verifiedDesign.feeOnly: Moved to settled explicit Subscribe action form; cold import no longer requires financial status discovery. Existing maximum-fee confirmation and two write phases retained.
verifiedDesign.failurePrivacy: Finite counters/stages and fixed errors; no selectors, private body or error text added to reports.
verifiedDesign.testScope: New tests are labelled observer/Fetch/fee UI seam tests. They do not establish real cold transport, native chain, browser or full recovery acceptance.

Bind current SDK/wallet/artifact/source closure and prove native fresh contexts, full recovered state, exact paid receipt accounting and no extra proof/send under unchanged deadlines.
